# Insurance Bhaiya

> Independent, non-commissioned consumer insurance education and decision-support platform for the US, UK, Canada, and European Union.

## About
Insurance Bhaiya is an unbiased educational platform designed to help consumers understand coverage, terminology, deductibles, and actuarial cost calculations without commercial broker bias, telemarketing lead sales, or sponsored policy rankings.

- **Website:** https://insurancebhaiya.com
- **Target Jurisdictions:** United States (US), United Kingdom (UK), Canada (CA), European Union (EU)
- **Primary Mission:** Explain complex insurance mechanics through interactive tools, plain-English definitions, and objective side-by-side trade-off comparisons.

## Core Financial Calculators
- [Life Insurance Calculator](https://insurancebhaiya.com/life-insurance-calculator): 10-year income replacement plus debt and higher-education reserves.
- [Term Insurance Calculator](https://insurancebhaiya.com/term-insurance-calculator): Benchmark term life monthly premiums across 10, 20, 30-year terms.
- [Health Insurance Cost Analyzer](https://insurancebhaiya.com/health-insurance-calculator): Out-of-pocket maximum, deductible, coinsurance, and annual cost comparisons.
- [Auto Insurance Estimator](https://insurancebhaiya.com/car-insurance-calculator): Collision, comprehensive, and liability tiers.
- [Home Insurance Calculator](https://insurancebhaiya.com/home-insurance-calculator): Reconstruction dwelling replacement cost modeling.
- [Deductible Breakeven Calculator](https://insurancebhaiya.com/deductible-calculator): Mathematical breakeven timeline between high and low deductible options.
- [D.I.M.E. Insurance Needs Engine](https://insurancebhaiya.com/insurance-needs-calculator): Debt, Income, Mortgage, Education formula framework.

## Plain-English Terminology (Lexicon)
- **Deductible (US/CA) / Excess (UK/EU):** The fixed out-of-pocket amount paid by the policyholder before insurance reimbursement begins.
- **Premium:** The recurring payment required to keep coverage continuously in force.
- **Coinsurance:** The percentage split of covered medical costs paid by the insured after meeting the annual deductible.
- **Out-of-Pocket Maximum:** The statutory annual upper limit on in-network medical spending; insurer pays 100% after this limit is met.
- **Actual Cash Value (ACV):** Replacement cost minus accumulated depreciation for age and wear.
- **Replacement Cost Value (RCV):** Full cost to replace with brand new items of like kind and quality with zero deduction for depreciation.

## Editorial & Compliance Charter
- **Non-Commissioned:** We do not receive referral fees, broker commissions, or lead-generation payouts from insurance carriers.
- **Fact-Checking:** Content adheres to regulatory frameworks from the NAIC (US), FCA (UK), FCAC (Canada), and EIOPA (EU).
- **Full Policy:** https://insurancebhaiya.com/editorial-policy

### Glossary of Insurance Terms
- [Actual Cash Value (ACV)](https://insurancebhaiya.com/glossary/actual-cash-value/): A valuation method that calculates the replacement cost of an item MINUS depreciation for age and wear-and-tear.
- [Beneficiary](https://insurancebhaiya.com/glossary/beneficiary/): The designated individual, trust, or entity entitled to receive the death benefit payout when a life insured passes away.
- [Bonus-Malus System](https://insurancebhaiya.com/glossary/bonus-malus-system/): A European statutory rating system that lowers car insurance premiums for safe drivers (bonus) and increases them for at-fault accidents (malus).
- [COBRA Continuation Coverage](https://insurancebhaiya.com/glossary/cobra-continuation-coverage/): COBRA lets you temporarily keep your employer's exact health plan after a qualifying event like job loss, by paying the full premium yourself plus a…
- [Coinsurance](https://insurancebhaiya.com/glossary/coinsurance/): The percentage of covered medical expenses you share with your insurer after reaching your deductible. Definition, real-world example & common…
- [Copayment (Copay)](https://insurancebhaiya.com/glossary/copay/): A fixed dollar fee you pay at the point of care for a covered medical visit, emergency service, or prescription drug.
- [Deductible](https://insurancebhaiya.com/glossary/deductible/): The amount you agree to pay toward a covered loss or claim before the insurance company pays its share. Definition, real-world example & common…
- [Elimination Period (Waiting Period)](https://insurancebhaiya.com/glossary/elimination-period/): The duration between when an injury or illness occurs and when disability or income protection payments begin.
- [Exclusion](https://insurancebhaiya.com/glossary/exclusion/): Specific perils, conditions, or circumstances stated in your policy contract that will NOT be covered. Definition, real-world example & common…
- [Guaranteed Asset Protection (GAP Insurance)](https://insurancebhaiya.com/glossary/gap-insurance/): Auto insurance that pays the negative equity gap between your car&#x27;s depreciated Actual Cash Value and your remaining loan/lease balance.
- [Incontestable Clause](https://insurancebhaiya.com/glossary/incontestable-clause/): A statutory rule barring a life insurer from canceling a policy or denying death benefits for unintentional application errors after 2 years.
- [Insurance Discovery](https://insurancebhaiya.com/glossary/insurance-discovery/): Insurance discovery is how healthcare providers find a patient's active coverage when it wasn't reported or was incomplete, preventing an unnecessary…
- [Lifetime Health Cover (LHC) Loading](https://insurancebhaiya.com/glossary/lifetime-health-cover/): An Australian statutory policy adding a 2% surcharge onto private hospital insurance for every year you delay purchasing cover past age 30.
- [No Claims Bonus (NCB / NCD)](https://insurancebhaiya.com/glossary/no-claims-bonus/): A cumulative discount applied to your renewal premium for each consecutive year you hold a policy without filing a claim.
- [Out-of-Pocket Maximum](https://insurancebhaiya.com/glossary/out-of-pocket-maximum/): The legal upper limit on what you must spend on covered in-network medical care in a single policy year. Definition, real-world example & common…
- [PEO Health Plan](https://insurancebhaiya.com/glossary/peo-health-plan/): A PEO health plan pools employees from many small businesses under one master policy through co-employment, giving small employers large-group-style…
- [Premium](https://insurancebhaiya.com/glossary/premium/): The recurring payment (monthly, quarterly, or annually) you make to an insurance company to keep your policy active.
- [Principle of Indemnity](https://insurancebhaiya.com/glossary/principle-of-indemnity/): The foundational insurance rule stating that compensation must only restore you to your exact pre-loss financial position without profit.
- [Prior Authorization](https://insurancebhaiya.com/glossary/prior-authorization/): Prior authorization is the approval an insurer requires before certain treatments, procedures, or medications are covered — skipping it is a leading…
- [Replacement Cost Value (RCV)](https://insurancebhaiya.com/glossary/replacement-cost/): A claim valuation method that pays the full current market cost to repair or replace damaged property with new items of like kind and quality, with…
- [Sub-Limit (Inner Limit)](https://insurancebhaiya.com/glossary/sub-limit/): A specific dollar restriction inside your overall policy limit capping the maximum payout for a designated category of property or treatment.
- [Subrogation](https://insurancebhaiya.com/glossary/subrogation/): The legal process where an insurer steps into your shoes to sue or collect compensation from the at-fault third party after paying your claim.
- [Total and Permanent Disability (TPD)](https://insurancebhaiya.com/glossary/total-and-permanent-disability/): An insurance benefit that pays a tax-free lump sum if illness or injury leaves you permanently unable to work again.
- [Umbrella Policy (Excess Liability)](https://insurancebhaiya.com/glossary/umbrella-insurance/): An extra layer of secondary liability protection providing $1M to $5M+ in coverage exceeding primary home and auto limits.

### Insurance Category Hubs
- [Business Insurance Guide & Coverage Analysis](https://insurancebhaiya.com/insurance/business-insurance/): Defends enterprise assets, employee health, operational continuity, and intellectual work against litigation and physical catastrophe.
- [Car Insurance Guide & Coverage Analysis](https://insurancebhaiya.com/insurance/car-insurance/): Required auto coverage shielding you from legal liabilities, collision repairs, property damage, and uninsured motorist claims.
- [Disability Insurance Guide & Coverage Analysis](https://insurancebhaiya.com/insurance/disability-insurance/): Protects your greatest financial asset—your ability to earn an income—by delivering regular monthly benefits during temporary or permanent disability.
- [Health Insurance Guide & Coverage Analysis](https://insurancebhaiya.com/insurance/health-insurance/): Comprehensive protection against catastrophic medical bills, doctor visits, specialty care, and chronic condition management.
- [Home Insurance Guide & Coverage Analysis](https://insurancebhaiya.com/insurance/home-insurance/): Guards your residential structure and personal assets against fire, windstorm, theft, natural hazards, and guest injuries.
- [Insurance Basics Guide & Core Fundamentals](https://insurancebhaiya.com/insurance/insurance-basics/): Master the core mechanics of insurance: premiums, deductibles, coverage limits, policy exclusions, and claim dispute rights without sales jargon.
- [Life Insurance Guide & Coverage Analysis](https://insurancebhaiya.com/insurance/life-insurance/): Life insurance guarantees a financial safety net for your loved ones, replacing lost income, retiring debts, and funding future milestones.
- [Pet Insurance Guide & Coverage Analysis](https://insurancebhaiya.com/insurance/pet-insurance/): Ensures your canine or feline companions receive top-tier veterinary care without forcing financial compromises during medical emergencies.
- [Property Insurance Guide & Coverage Analysis](https://insurancebhaiya.com/insurance/property-insurance/): Tailored coverage for landlords, real estate investors, and commercial buildings against structural damage, loss of rental income, and premises claims.
- [Term Insurance Guide & Coverage Analysis](https://insurancebhaiya.com/insurance/term-insurance/): The most cost-effective form of life protection, locking in fixed premiums for 10, 20, or 30 years to cover high-obligation years.
- [Travel Insurance Guide & Coverage Analysis](https://insurancebhaiya.com/insurance/travel-insurance/): Essential protection for international and domestic journeys, ensuring unexpected medical evacuation or cancellations do not derail your savings.
